mapper.select:

mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow SET code=#{code}, name=#{name}, description=#{description}, task_question=#{taskQuestion}, summary_question_template=#{summaryQuestionTemplate}, enabled=#{enabled}, schedule_rules=#{scheduleRules}, max_parallelism=#{maxParallelism}, notify_enabled=#{notifyEnabled}, chat_public=#{chatPublic}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE skill_flow SET enabled= FALSE, deleted_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO skill_flow_execution (flow_id, flow_code, flow_name, summary_question_template_snapshot, max_parallelism_snapshot, notify_enabled_snapshot, trigger_type, trigger_user_id, conversation_id, original_question, data_date, status, active_guard_key, required_metric_count, ready_metric_count, missing_metrics_json) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{flowCode}, #{flowName}, #{summaryQuestionTemplateSnapshot}, #{maxParallelismSnapshot}, #{notifyEnabledSnapshot}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerUserId}, #{conversationId}, #{originalQuestion}, #{dataDate}, #{status}, #{activeGuardKey}, #{requiredMetricCount}, #{readyMetricCount}, #{missingMetricsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_node_execution (flow_execution_id, node_key, node_name, skill_id, skill_name, skill_retrieval_name, question_template_snapshot, rendered_question, depends_on_json, required, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at) VALUES (#{flowExecutionId}, #{nodeKey}, #{nodeName}, #{skillId}, #{skillName}, #{skillRetrievalName}, #{questionTemplateSnapshot}, #{renderedQuestion}, #{dependsOnJson}, #{required}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_execution WHERE flow_execution_id = #{flowExecutionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT t.* FROM skill_flow_trigger t JOIN skill_flow f ON f.id = t.flow_id WHERE t.enabled = TRUE AND f.enabled = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.id
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE active_guard_key = #{guardKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE status = 'WAITING_METRICS' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2000
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_execution SET status=#{status}, active_guard_key=#{activeGuardKey}, ready_metric_count=#{readyMetricCount}, missing_metrics_json=#{missingMetricsJson}, rendered_summary_question=#{renderedSummaryQuestion}, summary_json=#{summaryJson}, report_path=#{reportPath}, cancel_requested_at=#{cancelRequestedAt}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM skill_flow_node_execution n JOIN skill_flow_execution e ON e.id = n.flow_execution_id WHERE (n.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') OR (n.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.lease_expires_at < #{now} AND n.attempt_count < COALESCE(NULLIF(n.max_attempts, 0), 1))) AND (n.next_run_at IS NULL OR n.next_run_at <= #{now}) AND (n.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR n.lease_expires_at < #{now}) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_flow_node_execution r WHERE r.flow_execution_id = n.flow_execution_id AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.lease_expires_at >= #{now}) < GREATEST(COALESCE(e.max_parallelism_snapshot, 1), 1) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_node_execution SET status='RUNNING', attempt_count=COALESCE(attempt_count, 0) + 1, lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_expires_at=#{expiresAt}, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now} AND attempt_count < COALESCE(NULLIF(max_attempts, 0), 1))) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_execution WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now} AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_node_execution SET status='RETRY_WAIT', next_run_at=#{now}, lease_owner=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, error_code='WORKER_RESTARTED', error_message='Previous worker stopped before completion', updated_at=NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_owner <> #{owner})
UPDATE skill_flow_execution SET status='SUMMARIZING', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE skill_flow_node_execution SET skill_retrieval_name=#{skillRetrievalName}, rendered_question=#{renderedQuestion}, status=#{status}, attempt_count=#{attemptCount}, next_run_at=#{nextRunAt}, lease_owner=#{leaseOwner}, lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, result_json=#{resultJson}, artifact_path=#{artifactPath}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE skill_flow_node_execution SET rendered_question=#{node.renderedQuestion}, status=#{node.status}, next_run_at=#{node.nextRunAt}, lease_owner=#{node.leaseOwner}, lease_expires_at=#{node.leaseExpiresAt}, result_json=#{node.resultJson}, artifact_path=#{node.artifactPath}, error_code=#{node.errorCode}, error_message=#{node.errorMessage}, completed_at=#{node.completedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{node.id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{expectedAttempt} AND lease_owner = #{expectedLeaseOwner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_node_attempt (node_execution_id, attempt_no, status, retryable, error_code, error_message, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms) VALUES (#{nodeExecutionId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{retryable}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{durationMs})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_node_attempt SET status=#{status}, retryable=#{retryable}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, duration_ms=#{durationMs} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE skill_flow_node_attempt SET status='FAILED', retryable= TRUE, error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED', error_message='Worker lease expired before completion', completed_at=#{now} WHERE node_execution_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_attempt WHERE node_execution_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY id
